title: Faster model-build source recovery
points: Structured provenance recovery now uses direct statement source URLs and page numbers when they are already present, instead of re-querying statement rows one by one.
Fresh deterministic model builds keep the same source-page evidence contract while avoiding avoidable D1 lookups.
The model-build eval harness can now run a focused build/update subset and records per-case timeouts as reportable failures.
